verses.2: The heavens record the deeds of God, and the works of His hands reveal His power.
verses.3: Day after day, he will declare his words; night after night, he will guide people’s understanding.
verses.4: There is no word or thing that does not have a sound.
verses.5: In all places, they rose up. At the edge of the sea, there was a sun that set up an altar for them.
verses.6: And he, as a bridegroom, stepped out of his hiding place. He was poor, like a shepherd who wanders around aimlessly.
verses.7: From the ends of the heavens, it comes forth; its edge is sharp on both sides. Nothing can hide from its heat.
verses.8: The word of Jehovah is true and righteous. It brings peace to the soul. It is a reliable source of truth.
verses.9: The commands of Jehovah are righteous and bring joy to the heart. They are the laws of Jehovah, which shine like light in our eyes.
verses.10: The fear of Jehovah is pure and lasting; it stands firm among the judgments of Jehovah. These judgments are true and just.
verses.11: We are honored by gold and great wealth; we are also pleased by the lush vegetation and the beautiful flowers.
verses.12: And your servants will also take care of them, keeping them safe.
verses.13: Mistakes that cannot be understood from their hidden meanings.
verses.14: And even those who are your servants, let them not be controlled by me. Then I will be freed from many sins.
verses.15: May my words and desires be pleasing to You, O LORD my God. May my heart be filled with gratitude and praise for Your presence.
